verse1.lyrics: I know your eyes in the morning sun
I feel you touch me in the pouring rain
And the moment that you wander far from me
I wanna feel you in my arms again

bridge1.lyrics: And you come to me on a summer breeze
Keep me warm in your love, then you softly leave
And it's me you need to show, how deep is your love?

chorus.lyrics: How deep is your love? How deep is your love?
'Cause we're living in a world of fools, breaking us down
When they all should let us be, we belong to you and me

verse2.lyrics: You know the door to my very soul
You're the light in my deepest darkest hour
You're my saviour when I fall

bridge2.lyrics: And you may not think I care for you
When you know down inside that I really do
And it's me you need to show, how deep is your love?

interlude.chords: C Em7 Dm7 | A7 Dm7 E7 F | C Em7 Am7 | Dm7 F
